items.excerpt: Ahead of the August 12 Made by Google event, leaks, renders and regulatory filings already sketch the Pixel 11 line and its Gemini Intelligence on-device AI layer.
items.title: Pixel 11 launch: Where to watch and what to expect from Google

items.excerpt: The InfiMaker K1 is a 5-axis desktop CNC mill that uses AI to turn a flat 2D image into a millable 3D model, aimed at makers with no machining background.
items.title: InfiMaker K1 is a desktop CNC mill that turns 2D images into 3D objects with AI

items.excerpt: An APK teardown shows Google preparing full Gemini Spark skill creation and management inside the Android app, moving custom AI agent workflows off the desktop and onto the phone.
items.title: You might soon be able to create Gemini Spark skills directly on your Android phone

items.excerpt: At least two Florida sheriff's offices have bought Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses, putting consumer AI eyewear into everyday law-enforcement workflows.
items.title: Smart Glasses Are Catching on With U.S. Police

items.excerpt: Caviar has turned the Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses into a $6,840 24-karat gold 'Odyssey' edition, an early sign that AI eyewear is being treated as a luxury design object.
items.title: The Company Behind Ugly Gold Phones Is Now Making Ugly Gold Smart Glasses

items.excerpt: A review of the $399 camera-less Xgimi MemoMind One display glasses, whose subscription-gated 'Moments' feature records and summarizes everything the wearer hears.
items.title: Xgimi MemoMind One Review: You Don't Want Smart Glasses That Record Everything You Say

items.excerpt: iOS 27 beta 5 adds Pace and Expressivity controls plus eleven voices to Siri AI, generated on-device and limited to iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air hardware.
items.title: Latest iOS 27 Beta Expands Siri AI Voice Customization

items.excerpt: Apple pushed the third iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 public betas, opening the rebuilt Siri AI - web search plus personal-context access - to non-developer devices.
items.title: Third iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 Public Betas Now Available

items.excerpt: Pixel Watch is getting a new Gemini overlay that renders on top of the watch face instead of launching a full app, mirroring the assistant's phone UI on the wrist.
items.title: New Gemini overlay for Wear OS rolling out to Pixel Watch

items.excerpt: The base Pixel 11 reportedly keeps 12GB of RAM but loses 'HiLight', the Gemini-reactive light strip, making the AI-feedback hardware a Pro-only signal.
items.title: Google's base Pixel 11 probably won't have 'HiLight' but will actually have enough RAM

items.excerpt: Rogbid's $69.99 VisionW pushes AI voice assistants (ChatGPT, Grok) into camera-less swappable-frame eyewear with a claimed 39-day battery.
items.title: New affordable 3-in-1 smart glasses promise up to 39 days of battery and UV protection

items.excerpt: KB5121003 lets Copilot+ PC owners remove the on-device image-generation AI component on its own, a first for unbundling Windows' local AI stack.
items.title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 August 2026 Patch Tuesday update
